title: Prometheus-alpha v0.2: extinction, reversal, a memory compiler and the location of the body's copy
status: Committed and hash-locked before any v0.2 experiment on a confirmatory rule (E0, E1, S0, S1, all trained and frozen for v0.1). v0.1 and its lock are unchanged.
code: src/prometheus/v2.py, importing the v0.1 engine and experiment code unchanged; locked with the v0.1 sources

protocol.life: as v0.1: grow 32, condition 48, delay 12; complete decapitation; regenerate 32; test 24
protocol.extinction: 2 blocks of the conditioning schedule with no shock (96 steps), then 12 steps; the comparison arm waits the same 108 steps with no presentations
protocol.reversal: after the first lesson, a second paired conditioning with the other odour as CS+ (the unpaired twin gets it unpaired); memory scored against the first lesson
protocol.compiler: Adam (lr 0.05, 150 iterations, L2 0.01) on a 10 x 40 hidden-channel pattern added to the living cells of 32 decapitated unpaired design worms (seed 3120) to make the regrown head's R(A)-R(B) = +1 (and -1 for B); tested on 128 held-out decapitated unpaired worms (seed 3121); control: the same values permuted across body sites 12-35, per channel

H8.claim: Attractor (replicating the v0.1 post-hoc finding on fresh seeds): after 4 Promethean cycles the memory of the rule's favoured odour exceeds the memory of the other
H8.measure: mean M of favoured-odour worms minus mean M of other-odour worms after cycle 4

H9.claim: Extinction: unreinforced presentations weaken the memory of intact worms

H10.claim: Extinction through regrowth: the memory in a head regrown after extinction differs from the memory of the intact extinguished head

H11.claim: Reversal through regrowth: after a reversal, the regrown head's memory of the first lesson differs from the intact head's

H12.claim: Memory compiler: a designed hidden pattern written into held-out untrained decapitated bodies makes their regrown heads prefer the designed odour, more than the same values at shuffled sites
H12.measure: written = (pref with A pattern - pref with B pattern)/2 minus the same for the shuffled patterns, per worm

H13.claim: Engram locus: the trained body's hidden channels implanted at only the 4 sites next to the wound (12-15) transfer more memory than the same channels implanted at the rest of the trunk (16-27)
H13.measure: M(edge implant) - M(rest implant), per worm

decision_rules.family: H8-H13 per rule (H8 in S rules only); Holm at alpha 0.05
decision_rules.sesoi: Holm rejection and |mean| >= 0.10, as in v0.1
decision_rules.replication: supported in both rules of a family
decision_rules.interpretation: H10, H11 and H13 concern the body's copy and are only interpretable in rules whose memory survives decapitation (S). In E rules they are reported but restate v0.1 H2.

predictions.H8: S0, S1: supported (pilot S102: favoured 0.83 vs other 0.44 after cycle 4)
predictions.H9: S rules: supported (pilot S102: 67% extinguished). E rules: not supported (pilot E102: unreinforced presentations strengthened the memory, 0.35 -> 0.58)
predictions.H10: S rules: supported with a negative sign, the regrown head is more extinguished than the intact one, even inverted (pilot S102: +0.26 intact, -0.39 regrown). E rules: supported, negative, trivially (no memory survives regrowth)
predictions.H11: S rules: supported with a negative sign, the body keeps the newer lesson (pilot S102: first lesson +0.15 intact, -0.42 regrown). E rules: supported, negative, trivially
predictions.H12: S rules: supported (pilot S102: written 1.00 vs shuffled 0.07, n = 32). E rules: no prediction
predictions.H13: S rules: supported (pilot S102: the 4 wound-edge sites carried 74% of the memory; every other 4-site window < 1%). E rules: not supported

disclosed_pilots: All v0.2 experiments were piloted at n = 32 on pilot rules S102 and E102 (results/pilot/v2_pilot_n32.json) before this lock, using the confirmatory cohort seeds at n = 32 (different worms from n = 128). The pilot fixed EXT_BLOCKS = 2, the compiler settings, and turned H10 and H11 from one-sided (renewal; the older lesson survives) into two-sided tests after the pilot showed the opposite direction. H13 was added after the pilot engram map.
deviations: Any departure after the lock goes in docs/DEVIATIONS.md under v0.2.
